title: PRISM-RX Sentinel: Pre-Demodulation Baseband Hardware Security Boundary on SkyWater 130nm (Tiny Tapeout TT08)
description: Synthesizable Verilog 3-layer hardware security perimeter targeting Tiny Tapeout TT08 (SkyWater 130nm) to protect Sub-GHz RF receivers against baseband glitches, clock desynchronization, and malformed frame injection with deterministic 1-cycle fail-closed isolation.
